review_candidates.description: Design Engineer – Data Centres Finland | Weekly allowance + Accommodation & Flights for Expats | 17:4 OR 5 week on / 1 week off rotation Your new company We are working with a leading international data centre construction and delivery organisation, specialising in the design, construction and commissioning of large-scale, mission-critical facilities across Europe. With a strong reputation for delivering complex data centre developments, the business is continuing to expand its project teams to support a growing portfolio of major infrastructure projects. They are now looking to appoint a Design Engineer to join their team in Finland, offering the opportunity to work on a major data centre development alongside experienced engineering and construction professionals. Your new role You will join the project delivery team, supporting the Design Manager in the coordination and delivery of engineering designs from initial development through to construction and commissioning. Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, BIM specialists, consultants and subcontractors, you will play a key role in ensuring design information is accurate, coordinated and delivered in line with project requirements and programme deadlines. You will: Support the development, coordination and review of project designs, drawings, engineering calculations and technical specifications. Coordinate with internal engineering disciplines, BIM teams and external consultants to ensure designs are fully integrated and clash-free. Assist with the preparation, review and coordination of Technical Submittals (TS), ensuring compliance with project specifications. Manage Requests for Information (RFIs) and technical design queries, working with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely resolutions. Identify design discrepancies, technical issues and constructability challenges before they impact construction activities. Maintain design trackers, technical submittal registers, RFI logs and design revision records. Support design change management, identifying potential impacts on project cost, programme and construction methodology. Work closely with construction and quality teams to ensure designs are practical, buildable and compliant with project standards. What you'll need to succeed Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction or a related discipline. Minimum 2 years' experience in a Design Engineering role within construction, engineering consultancy or contracting. Experience working on large-scale construction projects, ideally within data centres, pharmaceutical, industrial or commercial developments. Good understanding of design coordination, engineering principles, construction methodologies and technical documentation. Experience with BIM processes and digital construction tools is advantageous. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with AutoCAD, Revit or similar design software beneficial. Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills. A proactive, detail-oriented and solution-focused mindset, with the ability to coordinate across multiple engineering disciplines. What we're offering You will join an established international organisation delivering some of Europe's most significant data centre developments. This is an opportunity to gain valuable experience within the rapidly expanding data centre sector, working alongside experienced engineering and construction professionals on a major project in Finland. With a competitive salary package, collaborative working environment and opportunities for professional development and career progression, this role is ideal for a Design Engineer looking to take the next step in their career within mission-critical construction. Next steps This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing project team and play a key role in the delivery of a major data centre development. If you have a background in design engineering and are looking to develop your career within the data centre sector, we want to hear from you.

review_candidates.description: Contributor / Writer: Fashion, Creative and Sports Africa’s Very Own (AVO) is a digital culture magazine from Southern Africa, published since 2018. We cover fashion, creative work and sports, and the people behind them. We are looking for contributors who can give the time to write and submit at least one article every week. Please apply only if you can commit to that: it matters more than anything else in this post. Choose your section Fashion: the people and work behind how Southern Africa dresses and presents itself: fashion designers, stylists, modelling, pageantry, make-up, beauty, hair, etc.. Creative: the people making a living from creativity, such as actors, musicians, photographers, designers, filmmakers, comedians, content creators, etc. It is also home to our music, lyrics, poetry, short stories, book reviews and profiles of people building careers and businesses. Sports: Southern Africa’s athletes, teams and the people behind the results, from athletics to football, rugby and cricket. You apply for one section. What you will do Write and submit at least one article every week for your section Pitch stories that fit your section and AVO’s direction Interview people and write features, profiles, reviews and opinion Work with your editor and hit the deadlines you agree to Stay reachable on WhatsApp, where the team coordinates Join at least one virtual meeting with the editorial team every week Keep your author profile and contact details up to date A typical week Agree a story with your editor, or pitch one that fits your section. Research it and interview the people in it. Write it yourself and submit at least one finished article before the week ends. Answer your editor’s notes and revise until it is ready to publish. How it works You pitch stories, interview people, write them up and work with an editor to get them ready. Editors decide what is commissioned and published, so not every pitch makes it, but you will always get a straight answer. What we are looking for You can commit to writing and submitting at least one article every week, and you care about your section Every word is yours. We do not allow AI writing: AI can help you check spelling and grammar, transcribe your own recording or do background reading, but it cannot draft or write any part of a story, a quote or a headline. Work that breaks this rule is not published You write well in English Something we can read: published work, a blog, a portfolio or a short sample You are accurate and fair, and you follow our Contributor Terms You have permission for any photos or material you send You are fine with the unpaid arrangement for now What you get now Your name on your stories, an author page that shows you as a contributor, an editor who works on your pieces with you, in-person training, access to AVO’s online academy, and a place to build a name in your lane.
